$comment: launchfilm music library: CC0 and CC BY 4.0 instrumental beds only (no NC/SA/ND, no Pixabay/Mixkit/YouTube Audio Library/ElevenLabs). Audio files are NOT committed: node scripts/fetch-music.mjs downloads them here. CC BY tracks need their attribution line in the post/description (npx launchfilm post adds it).
